scenario: [LIMP.2.1.7] / [LGRA.22.5] — `import … as` aliasing, both forms. `import ha as h` binds the library qualifier `h`; the call names `ha`'s service bare, `svc.foo`, since a service is not reached through a library (LGRA.10.1.6), and `from hb import Sensor as BSensor` binds the selective name under the alias `BSensor` (used here as a pattern). Aliasing lets an author bring names into scope under a chosen local name; it is the tool that resolves a same-name collision, since a name's role is fixed by its position and comparison is case-sensitive. Both aliased names resolve and the program compiles.
rules_ds:
import ha as h
from hb import Sensor as BSensor

schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule use_bsensor:
    BSensor
->
    log info "b"

rule trigger:
    Trig
->
    call svc.foo cooldown: 30_s as "corr1"

libraries.ha:
service svc.foo:
    kwarg dummy: Int
    no response
libraries.hb:
schema Sensor scope logical:
    id: String key
